title: Proof-of-Work Simulator with Adjustable Difficulty
description: Simulates mining on a toy blockchain, plots how block time varies with difficulty and network hash power and shows how difficulty adjustment keeps block intervals steady.

title: Multi-Signature Wallet Contract with Spending Limits
description: Implements a wallet requiring several approvers for large transfers, lets small daily spends through, and tests approval, revocation and replay cases with a documented test plan.

title: Decentralised Voting Prototype with Eligibility Proofs
description: Lets registered voters cast a ballot once without revealing their choice to others, using a commitment scheme and eligibility proof, and documents attacks the prototype does not defend against.

title: Supply Chain Provenance Ledger on Hyperledger Fabric
description: Records custody changes of goods between organisations on a permissioned ledger with endorsement rules, and compares what the ledger guarantees with what a shared database could do.

title: Token Vesting Schedule Contract with Fuzz Testing
description: Releases tokens to team members on a schedule with cliff periods and revocation, and uses fuzz and invariant testing to show the total released never exceeds the total granted.

title: Peer-to-Peer Gossip Network Simulator
description: Simulates how transactions spread across a network of nodes using gossip, measures propagation time and redundancy for different fan-out settings and node failure rates. Includes plots of how reach grows per round.

title: Verifiable Certificate Registry on an Ethereum Test Network
description: Lets an institution issue tamper-evident certificates by recording hashes on a test network, and gives employers a page that verifies a document without contacting the institution.

title: Rust Light Client that Verifies Block Headers
description: Implements a minimal client that checks header chains and Merkle inclusion proofs without downloading full blocks, and measures bandwidth saved against a full node. Includes tests with deliberately corrupted headers and proofs.
